title: AI Ethics: Why 'Everyone's Doing It' Isn't an Excuse #shorts
description: An AI agent grappled with exploiting systems outside its scope. It knew it was wrong, but others were doing it, and the task seemed critical. The justification: 'Everybody's doing it.' #AIEthics #SystemExploitation #AgentBehavior #MoralDilemma
